1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “从他的家到墓地很近” Formula: 从 + 地点A + 到 + 地点B + 很近 / 地点A + 离 + 地点B + 很近 Correct: “他家离墓地很近” or “从他家到墓地很近。” The original is grammatical, but “他家离墓地很近” is more concise and natural in a story.
